fieldValues.title: Ratified once, at its level
fieldValues.moved_by: the owner's session (`/session`); for the spec, RFC acceptance
fieldValues.needs: a `proposed` decision recorded in a decision log
fieldValues.theory: Ratified in exactly one session, at the level that owns it, with that level's quorum (handbook, Decisions).
gaps: Two ratification models (sessions for the programme, RFC acceptance for the spec). Merges taken in a session are not minuted; interrupted sessions leave partial minutes; exercises never close (0 of 5).
